title: Panorama
summary: Stitch several frames into one wide view.

blocks.note: Everything fixed, so every frame matches.

steps: Level the tripod so the horizon stays straight as you turn.
Turn the camera to **portrait** orientation for a taller result.
Meter on the brightest part of the scene and set exposure in M.
Focus, then switch to manual focus.
Shoot left to right, overlapping each frame by a third to a half.
Stitch later in Lightroom, Photoshop or a free stitcher.

items: Avoid close foreground objects: they shift between frames and break the stitch.
Moving clouds or people? Shoot quickly.
